verdict.rationale: Direct probe evidence confirms an llms.txt file exists at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and per-page markdown docs (e.g. tax.md) are also served, allowing agents to fetch agent-oriented documentation directly. This is Stripe-wide infrastructure that applies to the Tax docs specifically (stripe-tax-docs-2 sourced from tax.md). Missing for 10: no evidence of a dedicated llms-full.txt or Tax-specific agent guide, and no independent/community confirmation of agents successfully using this in practice.
